title: Al Jazeera Obtains Full Text of Pentagon's NATO Loyalty Questionnaire; NATO Official Says It 'Confuses NATO Topics with Unilateral US Military Operations'
detail: Al Jazeera reported August 19, 2026 that it had exclusively obtained the underlying three-page Pentagon document — titled "Questions for NATO Allies & Other Key Stakeholders" — first disclosed by Bloomberg on August 14. The full text shows the questionnaire cites specific instances of friction, including Spain's closure of its airspace to US aircraft in March 2026 during the Iran campaign and Madrid's attempt to seek an exemption from the 2025 pledge to raise defense spending to 5% of GDP. A senior NATO defense official told Al Jazeera the exercise "has been confusing NATO topics with unilateral US military operations," while a European official said it reflects the Pentagon's effort to build a case for "specific, almost vindictive force presence reductions" and to signal that allies should stay "on the good side of the White House" by aligning closely with its agenda. The document lands partway through the Pentagon's six-month Europe force-posture review (expected to conclude by December 2026), deepening alliance concern that US troop and equipment levels are being tied to political alignment rather than treaty commitments.
